answer:
Your Training note now has an app on its App side, and the app check came back clean. I haven't tried it with your real data on a phone.

- **Today:** It opens on your next workout. Today is Monday, so you get Mon's squat, bench and row. Pick Mon, Wed or Fri with the day buttons. Each exercise has big set buttons. Tap a set to mark it done at the target reps. Tap again for one rep fewer, and keep tapping to clear it. It shows your last weight and suggests a bump (+2.5 kg, or +5 on deadlift) once you've hit every rep. Save adds a row to your log table, or updates today's row if there is one.
- **Plan:** You can rename exercises and change sets and reps (a number or "max"). You can also add or remove exercises and days. Every change goes straight into the plan text in your note.
- **Progress:** It shows a weight-over-time chart per exercise, your best weight, and training days in total and this month. Below that is a history with volume.

I made two small changes to the note's text. The old "Plan (3 days a week)" line is now a "Plan" heading, because the app needs a heading to write the plan back to. The log table now sits under a "Log" heading. Your plan lines and log rows are unchanged.

Adding a day in the Plan tab starts it with a placeholder "New exercise", so rename it there.
